## Tables

Every table this repository declares (`canceronice.schemas.TABLES`),
grouped by namespace, with its comment, its business key, and every
column's own doc string. A table not yet populated in the live catalog

### `raw` — Sources as landed, verbatim, per source release.

#### `raw.bls__laus_area`

BLS LAUS area code lookup (la.area), landed verbatim and whole per vintage.

**Sorted by:** `laus_vintage, area_type_code, area_code`  

| Column | Type | Required | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `area_type_code` | string | yes | BLS area classification letter. 'F' is county/county-equivalent -- the only level this module derives from; other codes (state, metropolitan area, balance-of-state, etc.) are landed for reference but not used. |
| `area_code` | string | yes | 'CN' + 2-digit state FIPS + 3-digit county FIPS + 8 zeros for a county-equivalent area, e.g. 'CN0100100000000' (Autauga County, AL). |
| `area_text` | string | yes | Human-readable area name. |
| `display_level` | string |  | BLS display grouping, as published. |
| `selectable` | string |  | 'T'/'F', as published. |
| `sort_sequence` | string |  | BLS display sort order, as published. |
| `laus_vintage` | string | yes | See raw.bls__laus_county. |
| `landed_in` | string | yes | The cancerOnIce release whose ingest landed these rows. |

#### `raw.bls__laus_county`

BLS LAUS county-level (area_type_code='F') monthly + annual-average data, landed verbatim and whole from la.data.64.County. Public domain (BLS is a federal agency).

**Sorted by:** `laus_vintage, series_id, year, period`  

| Column | Type | Required | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `series_id` | string | yes | BLS series id, 'LAUCN<5-digit FIPS>00000000<measure_code>' -- e.g. 'LAUCN010010000000003' is Autauga County AL (01001), measure 03. Every row of this file carries the 'LAUCN' county prefix (verified against the full real file, 3,225 areas). |
| `year` | string | yes | 4-digit calendar year. |
| `period` | string | yes | 'M01'-'M12' for a calendar month, 'M13' for the annual average (la.period, landed in raw.bls__laus_measure's sibling la.period is not landed separately -- its 13 values are exactly M01-M13, not worth a lookup table of its own). |
| `value` | string |  | The published value, unparsed. A literal '-' means not available (footnote_codes explains why); never silently cast to a number. |
| `footnote_codes` | string |  | FK to raw.bls__laus_footnote.footnote_code; NULL when the value carries no footnote. |
| `laus_vintage` | string | yes | Retrieval-date vintage (SPEC.md's versioning model: BLS revises prior months in place, so the flat file's version axis is when it was retrieved, not a label BLS publishes). Raw is replaced wholesale per value of this column; several retrievals with identical bytes are one vintage (bls_laus.py skips landing a repeat). |
| `landed_in` | string | yes | The cancerOnIce release whose ingest landed these rows. |

#### `raw.bls__laus_footnote`

BLS LAUS footnote code lookup (la.footnote), landed verbatim and whole per vintage -- the real, complete set of sentinel/reliability codes this source publishes (bls_laus.py's FOOTNOTE_TEXT mirrors it and SystemExits on a code not in this table).

**Sorted by:** `laus_vintage, footnote_code`  

| Column | Type | Required | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `footnote_code` | string | yes | Single-letter footnote code, e.g. 'N' = not available. |
| `footnote_text` | string | yes | Footnote text, as published. |
| `laus_vintage` | string | yes | See raw.bls__laus_county. |
| `landed_in` | string | yes | The cancerOnIce release whose ingest landed these rows. |

#### `raw.bls__laus_measure`

BLS LAUS measure code lookup (la.measure), landed verbatim and whole per vintage.

**Sorted by:** `laus_vintage, measure_code`  

| Column | Type | Required | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `measure_code` | string | yes | 2-digit measure code, e.g. '03' = unemployment rate. |
| `measure_text` | string | yes | Human-readable measure name. |
| `laus_vintage` | string | yes | See raw.bls__laus_county. |
| `landed_in` | string | yes | The cancerOnIce release whose ingest landed these rows. |

#### `raw.bls__laus_series`

BLS LAUS series identification lookup (la.series), landed verbatim and whole per vintage. Not read by this module's derive step -- the county data file's own series_id already encodes area + measure (raw.bls__laus_county's doc) -- landed for reference and for a future series-title/date-range lookup need.

**Sorted by:** `laus_vintage, series_id`  

| Column | Type | Required | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `series_id` | string | yes | See raw.bls__laus_county. |
| `area_type_code` | string | yes | See raw.bls__laus_area. |
| `area_code` | string | yes | FK raw.bls__laus_area. |
| `measure_code` | string | yes | FK raw.bls__laus_measure. |
| `seasonal` | string | yes | 'S' seasonally adjusted, 'U' not. Every county-level series is 'U' (verified against the full real file) -- LAUS publishes no seasonally-adjusted county series. |

Queries wanting current data must filter on valid_to IS NULL; queries wanting release R want valid_from <= R AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > R). This is a cancerOnIce release, not the date the source changed the record. |

### `provenance` — What each cancerOnIce release was built from, and how we know.

#### `provenance.release`

One row per (cancerOnIce release, source, source_version): what this release was built from. This is what makes a release reproducible — resolve it here to each source's own version, then query each table at that release. Durable by design: unlike Iceberg snapshot summaries it does not expire. Keyed on source_version too (#78) so landing several source releases of one source under one catalog release keeps a row for each.

**Business key:** `release, source, source_version`  
**Sorted by:** `release, source, source_version`  

| Column | Type | Required | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `release` | string | yes | cancerOnIce release, YYYY.MM with zero-padded corrections YYYY.MM.NN. Zero-padded because '2026.10.10' sorts before '2026.10.2' and release ordering would otherwise invert. |
| `source` | string | yes | Source key, e.g. scp, places, acs. |
| `source_version` | string | yes | The upstream version in the SOURCE'S OWN vocabulary, never normalised. Part of the business key together with release and source (#78): several source releases can land under one catalog release, and keying on (release, source) alone kept only the last one landed. Always populated — merge.manifest defaults it to the retrieval date when the source publishes no version label of its own, so it is never NULL. |
| `version_method` | string | yes | How the version was determined: release_number, http_last_modified, etag, ftp_index_probe, retrieval_date, unavailable. 'unavailable' is a legitimate value — a source that publishes no version is recorded as such, never given a fabricated one. |
| `retrieved_at` | string | yes | UTC timestamp at which the source was fetched. |
| `url` | string |  | Canonical URL fetched. |
| `checksum` | string |  | SHA-256 of the retrieved bytes, where computed. |
| `row_count` | int |  | Rows landed from this source, as a cheap integrity check. |
